title: Strike IV and delta shown to every user (G-19-2)
reference_behaviour: The picker offers LTP, OI and Greeks column sets to every user; none is limited to an advanced level.
ours: REQ-080 AC-2 adds IV and delta only at the Advanced level (ADR-056). ADR-168 (4)(5) removes levels; with the picker not built, build it without the gate.
